connect-hint: No fingerprint reader, security key or OpenPGP card found. Insert the key: this panel notices it by itself.

error.fp-in-use: The fingerprint reader is in use by another program.
error.fp-no-device: The fingerprint reader is no longer available.
error.fp-no-prints: No fingerprints are enrolled on this reader.
error.fp-not-deleted: The fingerprint could not be deleted.
error.fp-permission-denied: Not authorized to use the fingerprint reader.
error.helper: Couldn't run the noctalia-security-hw helper: check the plugin's "helper" setting.
error.import-failed: Couldn't find the public key at the card's URL or on the keyservers. Import it from a file.
error.no-pin: sudo and polkit ask for this key's PIN, and it has none: set a PIN on the key before registering it.
error.no-test-service: The PAM service {detail} doesn't exist here.
error.not-target: sudo and polkit wouldn't read a key registered here.
error.pin-blocked: The PIN is blocked after too many wrong tries: unplug and reinsert the key, or reset it.
error.secret-on-disk: gpg keeps a secret part of this key on disk, not only on the card: nothing was removed.
error.ssh-config-conflict: Another key already sets up {detail} with another login or port.
error.ssh-config-edited: {detail} wasn't written by this panel, or was changed by hand: it is left alone.
error.ssh-config-foreign: {detail} wasn't written by this panel: it is left alone.
error.ssh-config-link: ~/.ssh/config is a symbolic link without "Include config.d/*.conf": add it (in home-manager, programs.ssh.includes) so ssh reads the files this panel writes.
error.ssh-damaged: {detail} isn't a resident key copy this panel can read: nothing was deleted.
error.ssh-encrypted: {detail} has a passphrase, so its key can't be found on the security key: nothing was deleted.
error.ssh-exists: The security key already holds a key for {detail} with this user ID: replacing it deletes the old one for good.
error.ssh-file-exists: {detail} is already there: move it away, or choose another user ID.
error.ssh-none: The security key holds no SSH keys.
error.ssh-not-on-key: This copy's key isn't on the security key plugged in (it was replaced, or made on another key): nothing was deleted.
error.test-failed: The key was refused: it isn't registered, or wasn't touched.
error.timeout: The key wasn't touched in time.

fido.credential-unused: Key {index} · {label} (not used by sudo or polkit)
fido.none: No key registered for you yet.
fido.register-detail: The key's PIN, if it has one, then a touch.
fido.registered-first: Key registered. Register a second key too, in case this one is lost.
fido.subtitle: FIDO2/U2F (pam_u2f): sudo, polkit and the lock screen accept the key instead of your password.

target.mixed: sudo and polkit read keys from different files, so a key registered here wouldn't work for both: an administrator has to point them at the same file.
target.no-pam: sudo and polkit don't ask for a security key: an administrator has to enable pam_u2f first.
target.other-file: sudo and polkit read keys from {path} (yours there: {count}), and this panel can't save keys in that file: an administrator has to register them.

fido.test-detail: Authenticates with the PAM service {service}, as the lock screen does.
fido.title: Sign in with the key

status.data-full: The reader has no room for more fingerprints.
status.finger-not-centered: Center your finger on the reader.
status.remove-and-retry: Lift your finger and try again.
status.stage-passed: Lift your finger and touch the reader again.
status.swipe: Swipe your finger across the reader.
status.swipe-too-short: Swipe was too short. Try again.
status.touch: Touch the reader with your finger.

fingerprint.subtitle: Fingerprints unlock the screen and authorize administrative actions.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint reader

gpg.file-placeholder: Path of a public key file
gpg.imported: Public key imported and linked to the card.
gpg.offline: Offline mode is on: import the public key from a file.
gpg.removed: Removed from the keyring; the key stays on the card.

state.public: The public key is there, but not linked to the card yet.

gpg.subtitle: Sign, decrypt and authenticate with gpg using the keys stored on the card.
gpg.title: OpenPGP key on the card
gpg.trusted-done: The key is now ultimately trusted.
gpg.updated: Public key updated from the card's URL or the keyservers.

keys: Ctrl+Tab switches tabs · F5 refreshes · Alt+key on a button runs it · Esc closes
pin-touch: After the PIN, touch the key when it blinks.

ssh.algorithm-hint: ecdsa-sk for keys without Ed25519 (YubiKey firmware before 5.2.3).
ssh.application-hint: What the key is for, after "ssh:": a git host such as github.com, or empty.
ssh.copied: Public key copied to the clipboard.
ssh.create-detail: The key is made on the security key itself, then copied into ~/.ssh.
ssh.created: Created {name}. Its public key, for the server or git host:
ssh.delete-warning: This deletes the key from the security key itself: it can't be recovered or imported again, and every server or git host that trusts it needs a new key.
ssh.deleted: Deleted from the security key, with its copy: {name}
ssh.host-disabled: ssh no longer uses this key for {host}.
ssh.host-enabled: ssh now uses this key for {host}.
ssh.host-on: ssh uses it for {host}, without the agent.
ssh.host-suggest: Its button "Use for {host}" sets ssh up for that host.
ssh.import-detail: Copies every resident SSH key of the security key into ~/.ssh, never over a file already there.
ssh.invalid-application: Use letters, digits and . _ - @ : in the application, without "..".
ssh.invalid-comment: Use plain ASCII in the comment, up to 128 characters.
ssh.invalid-pub-name: The key's file name can't end in ".pub": choose another user ID.
ssh.invalid-user: Use letters, digits and . _ - @ in the user ID, without "..".
ssh.persist-hint: 0, the default, authenticates every new connection. Up to 1440 (24 hours): for that long, new connections to the host reuse an open one without the PIN or a touch, and removing the key doesn't close it.
ssh.persist-none: Each new connection to {host} authenticates again.
ssh.persist-set: Connections to {host} are reused for {minutes} minutes.
ssh.subtitle: SSH keys kept on the security key: copy them into ~/.ssh (on a new computer, for instance), or make new ones.
ssh.title: Resident SSH keys
ssh.touch-note: Each use of these keys still asks for a touch.
ssh.touch-off: Without a touch, sshd refuses the key unless authorized_keys allows no-touch-required.
ssh.user-hint: Tells apart keys for the same application: a new key with the same application and user ID replaces the old one on the security key. Empty for none.
